programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Lady in Grey
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate claims of a ghost lady in grey haunting Windleshaw abbey, St Helens, Merseyside. Over 600 years old and with new paranormal encounters reported almost weekly. Bex and Sean attempt to make contact with the infamous lady in grey.

programme.title: Ghost Dimensions Top 10 Scariest Moments
programme.desc: A special look into the top 10 of Ghost Dimension’s scariest moments. Venturing into the UK’s most haunted buildings, we take a look back at the scariest captures.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fort Crosby
programme.desc: Crosby Battery, also known as Crosby Point Battery and Fort Crosby, was an artillery battery situated between Crosby and Hightown in Lancashire, United Kingdom. The battery was used for port defence and anti-aircraft defence during WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Passage in Time
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Big Condo Studios in Liverpool, UK. Located in one of the most haunted cities in the world and believed to be haunted by some very playful spirits. Will they join the team on their investigation tonight?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1728
programme.desc: En heksedoktor sjekker inn på hotellet og nye par blir dannet. Et hemmelig oppdrag setter flere av gjestene i fare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1732
programme.desc: Liam og Nina prøver desperat å få tid alene. Stian kjenner på sjalusi. Er vennskapene i paradiset så sterke som deltakerne påstår, eller ligger et bedrag rett rundt hjørnet?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1733
programme.desc: Juryen har tatt sin avgjørelse, og en gutt sendes ut av hotellet. Jentene får et vanskelig valg som kan avgjøre skjebnen til en av guttene. Det går hett for seg på sesongens siste Pandoras.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1734
programme.desc: Alle frykter å stå mot juryens favoritter i en finale. Det blir høy temperatur på hjerteknuserseremonien.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1735
programme.desc: Det er klart for siste fest med en meget bitter jury. Alt gammelt "gnag" skal frem i lyset. Vil finaleparenes planer for å sanke stemmer virke?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1736
programme.desc: Det er FINALE på Paradise Hotel! Og den skal vise seg å bli mer nervepirrende enn noen av gjestene kunne sett for seg.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 631
programme.desc: Finalen nærmer seg med stormskritt! De gjenværende finalistene ønsker alle å stå i finalen, men i dag må de kommunisere godt med hverandre for å komme seg dit.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 632
programme.desc: Tre spente deltakere står klare for årets semifinale. Kjartan tester deltakerne i presisjon, teknikk og hurtighet, før den første finalisten kåres. Sesongens siste duell avgjør hvem som blir den siste finalisten.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 633
programme.desc: Finaledag på Camp Kulinaris! De tidligere deltakerne er tilbake! Dette til stor glede og motivasjon for de to finalistene. Det er duket for en hektisk og meget spennende finaledag. Hvem går seirende ut av årets sesong?

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 701
programme.desc: 10 kjendiser møter forventningsfulle opp i Portør! De neste 8 ukene skal de bo sammen, drifte en restaurant og lære av mesterkokken Kjartan Skjelde.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 702
programme.desc: Tempoet er høyt før Kjartan ankommer. Deltakerne håper de slipper å lage årets snack, som er teknisk vanskelig og tidkrevende. På kvelden bestemmer en av deltakerne seg for å forlate Portør.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 703
programme.desc: Dagen starter med katastrofe før sesongens første servering på Camp kulinaris. Klarer gruppen å redde stumpene, eller blir de første deltagergruppe noensinne som får første servering underkjent?

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Roger er tilbake på Gran Canaria etter en litt strevsom tur, og på hotellrommet oppstår det problemer med lysbryteren i år igjen. Familien Haider gjør comeback, men får en slitsom ankomst.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Familien fra Harstad er tilbake! Og for å slippe lastebiltrøbbel, har onkel Erling bestilt en sjåfør. Kai Thomas vil på stranda, men Aurora er mer opptatt av hundene sine.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Charter-Svein er tilbake, og med seg på lasset har han sine tre like energiske barn Noah, Liam og Ylva. Roger drar til havs for å fiske hai og har en opplevelsesrik tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Buskeruddamene har landet og er klare for irish og strawberry. De må bare få permobil-lappen først. Det er onkel Erlings drømmedag og han har planlagt aktiviteter for gjengen de sikkert vil elske.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305
programme.desc: Haider tar gladelig på seg rollen som Baywatch-stjerne da familien trenger opplæring i livredning. Rockeren Geir vil gjengjelde Fred Åges godhet og har planlagt en dag full av gaver og overraskelser.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306
programme.desc: På Gran Canaria tar kjærligheten, vennskapet og små hverdagsdramaer uventede vendinger. Haider håper på en romantisk date med Neelam, Pondern og Mutza sliter med å mestre en nøkkelboks.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 603

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 303
programme.desc: En gammel låve skal pusses opp i Bauge, og Halvor har sett at det ligger et enormt potensiale blant halmballer, skakke benker og gamle jordbruksredskaper.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 101

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 201
programme.desc: I kveld skal Halvor og gutta ta på seg veldig spesielt prosjekt i indre Telemark. Et gammelt forsvarsbygg skal forvandles til en moderne og stilren familiehytte

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 401

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2505

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2506

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Robin kaster bort alle pengene på dyre hobbyer. Det har akkurat blitt slutt med Madeleine fra forrige episode, og med sin skyhøye gjeld og heftige forbruk er den nye hverdagen vanskelig.

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Roy Erik kjøper og selger klokker annenhver uke og ekspertene har aldri sett liknende sløsing. Han kjøper på impuls og selger med tap. Han kan se langt etter drømmehuset med sin kjøpshistorikk.

programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Dilla på apefonetikk
programme.desc: Guttene konkurrerer mot hjemmeunderviste barn i South Parks årlige stavekonkurranse.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Midtbyen
programme.desc: South Parks bykjerne holder på å oppgraderes og Kenny bestemmer bestemmer seg for at det er på tide å skaffe en jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattige ungen
programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Vektøkning 4 000
programme.desc: Cartman vinner en skolekonkurranse ved å jukse. Mr. Garrison planlegger å drepe Kathy Lee Gifford, som skal dele ut prisen

programme.title: South Park: Anabole aber
programme.desc: Det er tid for 'Special Olympics' i South Park, og Cartman må overbevise kvalifiseringskomiteen om at han er funksjonshemmet, så han kan slå Jimmy.

programme.title: South Park: Tonsilltrøbbel
programme.desc: Cartman får AIDS etter en blodoverføring. Hvor langt er han villig til å gå for å finne en kur?

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: For mye informasjon
programme.desc: Etter en pinlig affære som involverer guttedeler, blir Cartman sendt på sinnemestringskurs og Randy prøver så godt han kan å takle det.

programme.title: South Park: Eric Cartmans død
programme.desc: Alle bestemmer seg for å ignorere Cartman, og han tror han er død og må finne fred ved å be om tilgivelse for det gale han har gjort.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman later som han har Tourettes, og gleder seg over å si hva han vil til hvem han vil. Riksdekkende TV er naturligvis snart på plass.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud
programme.desc: Cartman prøver å reise til fremtiden for å kjøpe et nytt dataspill.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman må dø
programme.desc: Cartman blir rasende på Scott Tenorman da rødhårede Scott lurer ham til å kjøpe kjønnshår for 16,12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: 99 % rotter seg sammen mot Eric Cartman.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Richard kappkjører en Bugatti mot et Eurofighter Typhoon-jetfly, Jeremy tester en Peel P50 Microcar, og James kjører en Rolls-Royce cabriolet.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Den nyeste Porche 911 blir satt på prøve. Teamet prøver også å få en Reliant Robin til å gå dit ingen trehjuler har gått forut.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Jeremy bygger en bil som er enda mindre enn den berømte Peel P50, og framlegger så konseptet for de fryktinngytende entreprenørene i Dragons' Den.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta prøver å gjenskape et tog med en bil som tauer en rekke campingvogner. Rowan Atkinson er ukens kjendis i en billigbil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy og James får i oppdrag å filme en informasjonsfilm om trygg sykling og må presentere den for et ekspertpanel.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Factories of Death
programme.desc: Året 1942 skal bli det mest betydningsfulle i "Den Endelige Løsningen", ettersom nazistene nå begynner å gjennomgå Vest-Europa og til og med tar jøder fra steder så fjernt som de britiske Kanaløyene.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Charo, William Mapother, Justin Guarini, Hope Dworaczyk
programme.desc: Charo is attacked by a deranged woman who killed herself 30 years prior in the same apartment; while on vacation in Hawaii with his family, a young William encounters the ghost of a woman from a leper colony.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Bill Bellamy, Dawn Wells, Jack Blades, Mary Lambert
programme.desc: Bill moves into a house that is inhabited by the ghost of a little girl who had a tragic accident there.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): D.B. Sweeney, Adrien Zmed, Eddie Money, DJ Nicole Leone
programme.desc: While seeking inspiration for their screenplay, D.B. and his friend stumble upon a motel and are accosted by a murderous entity.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Linda Blair, Carlos Mencia, Victoria Rowell, Dot Jones
programme.desc: Linda and her sister discover an old rundown house in the woods with a murderous history; Carlos Mencia is nearly shot and killed when a spirit from his past comes to his rescue.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Giancarlo Esposito
programme.desc: Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad / Revolution / The Usual Suspects) tells the story of his former home in Ridgefield, CT.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: During an overnight stay, Nick and Tessa aim to establish communication with the inn's sentient spirits.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Best of Special
programme.desc: A "Best Of" one hour special. Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost; Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Christopher Knight, Carol Alt, Dick Van Patten, Marissa Jaret Winokur
programme.desc: Young Christopher Knight is visited by the spirit of a tormented girl. And more.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: The Niagara State Parks Barracks, a site long abandoned and shrouded in mystery, stands as a no-go zone for tourists, not just because of its dilapidated state but also due to tales of haunting.

programme.title: Most Haunted: Tivoli Theatre
programme.desc: Tour a club known for its host of ghosts as a spectre stalks the investigators.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: This former Methodist Episcopal church in Bryan, Ohio, stands on ground once part of the town's original cemetery. Before the church's construction, graves were exhumed and moved, yet rumors persisted that six graves remained unaccounted for.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Underwater

programme.desc: Barney poses as a prospective rock-music recording artist to get evidence linking an organized crime figurehead played by guest star William Windom to the sudden death of a beautiful recording star who was being blackmailed by the syndicate.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 605
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel lengter etter mer plass før de snart utvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt når Mads ringer og forteller at avtalen med det nye huset deres i Langå ikke gjelder.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 701
programme.desc: Cecilie og Kristoffer bor med sin lille sønn i en sliten leilighet i Aarhus, men drømmer om mer plass og rolige omgivelser. Men hvor rolig blir man når man plutselig eier et hus man ikke føler seg hjemme i?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 702
programme.desc: Bianca og Morten bor i Randers med tett trafikk utenfor huset og har to små jenter som har lært seg å åpne ytterdøren. Det fungerer ikke, så de ber ekspertene om hjelp.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line og Kristian bygget drømmehuset sitt, trodde de i hvert fall. Åpne rom og store vinduer tiltaler dem ikke lenger, men hva skal de ha i stedet?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Getting Played
programme.desc: The gang goes on an exotic trip to India, but when their plane crashes in a deserted forest, their vacation turns into a dangerous game of survival.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Divide and Conquer
programme.desc: Realizing that they've become part of a real-life version of the Capsule Monsters board game, the gang struggles to find a way out.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her basement stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to unravel the circumstances surrounding Janice's death and answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath
programme.desc: Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate. The tribe's medicine men provided investigators with a critical clue that would lead halfway around the world to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Deceit
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool. Police narrow their search to one man: local policeman Randy Comeaux.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her infant son, the obvious suspect is the husband and father of the victims. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story of passion gone wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Ambition
programme.desc: When a policeman's house goes up in flames, experts suspect arson. The officer whose home was torched arrests low-level drug dealer James Wren, who confesses. But when the suspect vanishes, investigators question the authenticity of the confession.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Sizzling Sex Secrets!
programme.desc: Torrance admits to cheating on his girlfriend with a shocking twist. Then, Heather wants her boyfriend’s ex Tramisha to stop interfering with their relationship.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Forbidden Love
programme.desc: At twelve, Crystal dated 20-year-old Matt and was pregnant at 13. He served 15 months for sexual assault on a minor and is a registered sex offender. Is this inappropriate love or a misunderstanding?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 16-Year-Old Surrogate Stole Our Baby
programme.desc: Sarah was Dawn and Derek's surrogate, but took off while five months pregnant. Sarah claims that they took advantage of her. Who are the baby's rightful parents?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She's a Crazy Stalker
programme.desc: Victor met Jasmine a few years ago but claimed they never had sex. Jasmine claims that they fell in love and want him back! Who's telling the truth?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: These DNA Results Will Floor You
programme.desc: Joe met “Jessica” on a phone chat line. A few months later, she revealed she was pregnant. Then, Chastity claims that her ex Trent fathered her child. What will the DNA results reveal?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Chelse claims that her 19-month-old daughter is Malcolm's and that he beat her while pregnant. Amber and Phillip accuse each other of being abusive and want the polygraph tests to prove their claims!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
programme.desc: Tasha wants to prove to her ex Martin that he fathered her four-year-old. Martin's sister says that the child might belong to her boyfriend Terrence. Who's the real father?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: John 3:16
programme.desc: A man rushes his friend to the hospital with serious gunshot wounds, reporting they were robbed by strangers. When the facts don’t add up, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team go on the hunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: 24yr old Lorraine Laribo is dropped off at a bar by her sister's boyfriend. It's the last time anyone would ever see her alive again. Kenda must use his interrogation skills to find her killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Timothy Peart’s Last Dance
programme.desc: When a teen is killed at a party, police question the guests and wonder if they’re all part of a cover-up.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Second Case
programme.desc: A woman’s mangled body is found beside a lonely stretch of highway. When the coroner suspects foul play, Kenda is called in to solve the second homicide case of his career.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side
programme.desc: In terms of the Universe, we know we don't know much, especially when it comes to dark matter and dark energy. Scientists are devoting so much of their time to discovering as much as the possibly can about this mysterious matter.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.desc: A tornado in Oklahoma traps a family with nowhere to hide. Heavy rains in Tennessee put a construction crew in danger when a hillside crashes down. A flash flood ravages a trailer park, forcing a heroic rescue of mother and two daughters.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Illusionist
programme.desc: As humans, we construct our view of reality from the input provided by our senses. How does that work? And how can we make a robot experience something similar? What would the world be like with human minds and artificial ones living together?

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Ancient Black Ops: Assassins
programme.desc: In 11th-century Persia, the Ismailis, a Shiite sect, initiated a deadly campaign against Sunni leaders. Dubbed "Assassins" by their adversaries, their lethal tactics made them infamous, feared even by Christian and Muslim foes alike.

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: A local newspaper editor and businessman in South Africa unwittingly finds himself at the epicentre of a legend of buried gold that began during the Boer War.

programme.title: On the Case: Tip 1960
programme.desc: 19 year old Katie Poirier was working the night shift at a Convenience store when she was violently kidnapped. The abduction was captured on videotape but the images were not clear enough to identify her attacker.

programme.title: On the Case: The Doorbell Rang
programme.desc: The ring of a doorbell overheard during a teenager's final telephone call may be the key to solving her murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Call
programme.desc: When bartender Anita Andrews is stabbed to death inside her family's bar, police conclude her killer was the last patron she served that night.

programme.title: On the Case: Deep Wounds
programme.desc: After Navy electrician Michael Jacobs comes home to find his wife, Suzanne, and his three-year-old son, Colin, murdered, San Diego police race to catch a serial killer who leaves behind an unimaginable calling card.

programme.title: On the Case: Lost In The Fire
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother of two is found shot to death in her fire-ravaged home, police find there are more suspects than clues.

programme.title: On the Case: Predator on the Loose
programme.desc: A deadly predator haunts the city of Stockton, California and becomes more and more violent.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.desc: "Archenemy" star Joe Manganiello chats with Drew. Drew shares some never before seen moments from her chat with Adam Sandler. Personal finance expert Carmen Rita Wong shares tips. Drew tries out some weird food combos with TikTok star Eitan Bernath.

programme.desc: Jessica Biel tells Drew about dog sledding and plays "The Real Biel" trivia. Derek Blasberg joins Drew and Ross to cover news, including Dolly Parton's award and throwback fashion.

programme.desc: David Duchovny talks about his career and upcoming rom-com with Drew. Kirby Howell-Baptiste joins Drew and Ross for Drew's News, discussing dating and British foods.

programme.desc: Drew and Ross cover news about a senior dance troupe and a Jet-Puffed marshmallow pillow. Mark Anderson and Ryan Fey make skirt steak tacos. Damona Hoffman and Drew answer red flag questions.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Cameron Diaz, People Style Watch

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: President Joe Biden & First Lady Jill Biden

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mer Fare, Masse Trøbbel
programme.desc: Henry prøver å vende seg til sin nye rollen som Kid Danger, men sliter med å få kabalen skurkejakt, skole, familie og venner til å gå opp.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hemmelighet Avslørt
programme.desc: Henrys liv som Kid Danger står i fare ettersom Charlotte blir mer og mer mistenksom over alle hemmelighetene han prøver å skjule.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Munter-Billens Tårer
programme.desc: Captain Man mister på merkelig vis sine krefter, og blir redd for å dra på skurkejakt. Nå er det opp til Kid Danger å beskytte Solsyn og finne ut hvordan Captain Man kan få kreftene sine tilbake.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vikarlærer
programme.desc: En tvilsom ny elev dukker opp på skolen, og Charlotte og Henry tror han har noe muffens på gang. Captain Man går undercover som vikarlærer for å finne ut mer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jasper Danger
programme.desc: Jasper kler seg ut som Kid Danger på Halloween, men tar det litt for langt, og blir tatt for å være ekte vare. Nå er det opp til den ekte Kid Danger og Captain Man å komme og redde ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Steinen fra Verdensrommet
programme.desc: Trøbbel følger Henry hjem fra superhelt-livet da en stein fra verdensrommet viser seg å være mer enn den ser ut til.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Bursdagstrøbbel
programme.desc: Henry blir ikke invitert på bursdagsfest fordi han er blitt anklaget for å kaste et bursdagsbarn fra taket året før. Kaptein Man går med på å hjelpe Henry med å renvaske navnet sitt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tekniske Problemer
programme.desc: En ny elev, Shawn, tar Henrys plass på basketballaget, selv om Henry mistenker at han kan være eldre enn han hevder. Kaptein Man trenger hjelp fra en gammel venn, og må overvinne gammelt nag. Gjestestjerne: Russell Westbrook.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Mannebeistet Henry
programme.desc: Henry skal på et stort stevnemøte, men ting går ikke helt som planlagt etter at han tilfeldigvis blir eksponert for et merkelig apparat i Man-hulen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Vennen til Captain Man, Brad, som uheldigvis ble usynlig for en del år tilbake, kommer plutselig på besøk og blir lenger enn han burde.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spoiler-alarm
programme.desc: Henry og Ray må ordne opp med en ekstremt irriterende skurk. Piper må strekke seg langt når hun prøver å bli medlem av en populær Captain Man fanclub.

programme.desc: Gratulerer med dagen! Vår kanalen har fått en 25 års logo får å feire bursdagen til vår kule favorite svamp! Her finner du eventyrene og bestrebelsene til SvampeBob Firkant og vennene hans i vann i den fiktive undervannsbyen Bikini Bunnen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Sitter Tvillingvakt / Valpene Redder Fyrverkeriet
programme.desc: Ordfører Goodway ringer Paw Patrol for å få dem til å redde nevøen og niesen hennes ned fra et tre og for at de skal passe på tvillingene for en dag // Ordfører Goodway forventer en eske med fyrverkeri, men mottar en pakke med grisunger!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Hav-Valp
programme.desc: Når Valpene og Cap'N Turbot er ute under den veldig sjeldne Magiske Hav Månen, begynner magiske ting å skje. Lokket av den mystiske Hav-Valp sangen blir PAW Patrol plutselig forvandlet til Hav-Valper.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene på Glatta / Valpene Redder en Basketballkamp
programme.desc: En vinterstorm skaper trøbbel for hele Adventure Bukta. // Ordfører Goodway utfordrer ordfører Humdinger's basketballag til en kamp. Det eneste Ordfører Goodway mangler er et, Basketballag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Pizza / Valpene Redder Skye
programme.desc: Alex og Herr Porter leverer pizzadeig til et stort selskap når de mister kontrollen over bilen. Valpene må redde dem! // Skye er på vei til Jake-fjellet når hun krasjer i snøen. Ryder ringer Everest for å redde dagen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge
programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene lar Marshall Være Alene Hjemme / Valpene Redder Hjortefamilien
programme.desc: Når de andre valpene er på fallskjermtrening må Marshall få en gruppe med kattunger tilbake helt alene. // Ryder og PAW Patrol redder en hjortefamilie som sitter fast på den glatte isen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Venn / Valpene Redder en Blindpassasjer
programme.desc: Når Marshall bestemmer seg for å ta en pause fra Paw Control, slår valpene seg sammen for å få ham tilbake igjen. // Når Valpene finner en blindpassasjer på reisen til tundraen, må de redde en rømt kattunge i en rømt snowcat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Den Nye Valpen
programme.desc: PAW Patrol rykker ut for å redde Jake når han blir strandet i isødet, men en ny valp dukker også opp for å gi en hjelpende pote: den modige Everest!

programme.title: iCarly: Ja
programme.desc: Etter at en iCarly fan frir til kjæresten på nettshowet, blir gjengen nesten tvunget til å gå i bryllupet. Men når bruden får kalde føtter, må Carly komme til unnsetning.

programme.title: iCarly: T-skjortesalg
programme.desc: Gjengen begynner å selge Penny-skjorter, og når salget går susende, rekrutterer Sam barn fra 4. klasse for å bidra til å lage t-skjorter. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie er uenige om hvordan de skal behandles.

programme.title: iCarly: Rampestreker
programme.desc: Når hun blir ertet for aldri å ha funnet på en morsom spøk, rekrutterer Carly Spencer for å spøke med Sam og Freddie. Men etter at Spencer har fått sansen for det, kan han ikke slutte. Mob må finne en måte å stoppe ham på.

programme.title: iCarly: Moren til Sam
programme.desc: Etter å ha kranglet ned moren sin, flytter Sam inn til Carly, som snart innser at hun er en fryktelig gjest. Freddie blir forfulgt av en farlig kriminell etter å ha fanget ham på film da han begikk en forbrytelse.

programme.title: iCarly: Nevel trenger hjelp
programme.desc: Når en video av Nevel, som skriker til en liten jente, dukker opp på internett, blir Nevel hatet av alle. Men Nevel trygler iCarly-gjengen om hjelp for å redde sin ære.

programme.title: iCarly: Den kjekke assistenten
programme.desc: Carly og Sam ansetter en kjekk fyr som praktikant på nettshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: iOMG
programme.desc: Gjengen tilbringer kvelden med å fullføre sine prosjekter ved Ridgeway under den årlige skole-innlåsingen. Carly og Freddie mistenker at Sam er forelsket i sin nye venn Brad.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty med Victorious
programme.desc: Carly mistenker at den nye typen hennes, Steven, er utro med Tori Vega, så gjengen planlegger en tur til Los Angeles for å ta ham på fersken på en fest som Andre holder i Kenan Thompsons hus.

programme.title: iCarly: Datehjelpen
programme.desc: Carly trår til for å løse en krangel mellom Sam og Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie og Sam til Carly for å få hjelp med hver eneste krangel. Nå som hun har involvert seg, hvordan kan Carly trekke seg ut av det igjen?

programme.title: Game Shakers: Skremt på Halloween
programme.desc: Double G har skremt Triple G hver eneste Halloween siden han var baby. Dette året spør han Babe og Kenzie om hjelp, men de lurer ham ved å fortelle Trip om planen. Men det er ikke noe lurt å tulle med Dub.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Alleheltersaften
programme.desc: Det er kraftig uvær ute, men inne holder Kolosso Halloween i gang ved å fortelle tre skumle historier som garantert får den modigste superhelt til å bli stiv av skrekk.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Big Time skrekk og gru!
programme.desc: Det spøker i Palm Woods! Bord flytter seg, dører slamrer og Bitters er livredd for at gjestene skal rømme stedet. Samtidig har Gustavos hus fått en større vannlekkasje så han ber om å få overnatte hos Gutta og Mamma, noe han motvillig får lov til.

programme.title: Svampebob Firkant: Ikke se / Sjanse-seanse
programme.desc: Svampebob og Patrick ser skrekkfilm, og etterpå ser det ut til at den onde karakteren forfølger dem. // Svampebob holder en seanse på Den krispe krabbe for å skaffe oppskriften på en sandwich fra gamle dager.

programme.title: Bulderhuset: Vampyrene fra Melancolia / På kant med loven
programme.desc: Lucy er irritert for at Lori og Leni har begynt å se på hennes vampyr show på grunn av en ny, søt karakter. // Etter å ha fått samfunnstjeneste for å samle opp billetter, synes hun det er mer avslappende enn å være hjemme.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Monster oblant oss!
programme.desc: Da Turtles vender tilbake til en verden styrt av monstre, innser de at de kan ha forverret situasjonen.

programme.title: Big Time Rush: Big Time Halloween
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i Palm Woodsylvania og de monstrøse personlighetene til Big Time Rush blir kjent. James er en sexy vampyr, Logan er en zombie som mister kroppsdelene sine, Carlos er Franken-Carlos og Kendall er en varulv.

programme.title: Nicky, Ricky, Dicky & Dawn: Grøsserdans
programme.desc: Firlingene gleder seg til Halloween-dansen, og det samme gjør Tom og Anne, som skal være vakter. Dawn er redd for å bli bedt opp til dans, Ricky og Dicky konkurrerer om en jente, og Nicky velger et perfekt kostyme, mens Josie er DJ.

programme.title: All That: Episode 10

programme.desc: Leon, a hapless TV writer, buys an answering machine that has a mind of its own - it initially helps him out by providing him with new material, but Leon soon finds that it's taking over his life.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: In The Cards
programme.desc: A fake fortuneteller, Caterina, finds herself stuck with a cursed deck of cards that foretell death for everyone she does a prediction for.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Anniversary Dinner
programme.desc: A young girl fleeing her boyfriend finds herself in a small country home with a genial older couple. They take pity on her and invite her in, and even invite her to their special anniversary dinner.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Snip Snip
programme.desc: A warlock and a witch get into a battle over a $10 million lottery ticket when each claims that the spirits gave them the winning number.

programme.title: McLeods døtre
programme.desc: Grace stiller spørsmål ved Heaths kjærlighet til henne, helt til Heath overrasker med en fantastisk gave. Kate tar en dristig beslutning om å imponere Stevie og bli forfremmet til tilsynsmann.

programme.title: McLeods døtre
programme.desc: Det er julaften, og Alex kommer overraskende tilbake fra Argentina for å besøke Stevie. Første juledag ender tragisk når Grace, Riley, Tayler og Patrick havner i en bilulykke.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 801
programme.desc: Kate blir besatt av å bevise at Riley overlevde bilulykken, Grace prøver å finne personen som reddet henne, og Ingrid avslører at hun rømmer fra sin voldelige ektemann.

programme.title: McLeods døtre
programme.desc: Grace og Marcus er fanget i bunnen av en forlatt gruvesjakt. Vil hjelpen komme fram før Grace fryser ihjel?

programme.title: McLeods døtre
programme.desc: Stevies tidligere formann, Sharon, besøker Drovers og snur alles liv på hodet. Marcus ofrer sjansene sine i et stort hesteløp for å redde Ingrid fra en voldelig rytter.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Det er klart for en intens og spektakulær kamp med Kristin Gjelsvik, Dennis Poppe og Oskar Westerlin på det røde laget, mot Herman Dahl, Emilie "Emzia" Helgesen og Christopher Robin Omdahl på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Det er styrke, utholdenhet og akrobatikk som står i fokus når Anders Aukland, Martine Ek Hagen og Marthe Kristoffersen skal kjempe mot Lars Berger, Jonathan Nordbotten og Espen Jansen om den store gullskatten.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Dagens kamp står mellom Abu Hussain, Mayoo Indiran og Stian Sandø på det blå laget, og Alexandra Joner, Lene Orvik og Sebastian Solberg på det røde laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Det blir humor, spenning og høyt volum i dagens duell. Med Leif Einar "Lothepus" Lothe, Fetisha Williams og hennes far Byron Williams på det røde laget, og Fritjof Wilborn, Trude Mostue og Egil Andreas Skurdal på det blå laget.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny utvikler en dødelig sykdom, og Stan har problemer med å takle det.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: 99 % rotter seg sammen mot Eric Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Du yelper ikke til
programme.desc: Cartman ser seg som den beste restaurantkritikeren på nettet i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartman arver en million dollar fra bestemoren og virkeliggjør drømmen om å ha sin egen fornøyelsespark: Cartmanland!

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud XII
programme.desc: Cartman fryser seg ned og våkner opp 500 år inn i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: Barn med rødt hår
programme.desc: Cartman får 'gingervitus' og tar opp kampen mot forfølgelsen av rødhårede.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman suger
programme.desc: Butters blir sett i en kompromitterende stilling med Cartman og sendes til omvendingsleir for homofile. Cartman prøver å få tilbake et bilde av det som skjedde.

programme.title: South Park: Menneskebjørngrisen
programme.desc: Guttene hjelper tidligere visepresident Al Gore i jakten på oppmerksomhet og blir innesperret i en hule. Cartman prøver å finne veien ut og oppdager en skatt.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman har fått en angstdiagnose.

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans verdenskrig
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for å være en trussel mot hele menneskeheten.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy og James får i oppdrag å filme en informasjonsfilm om trygg sykling og må presentere den for et ekspertpanel.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Storbritannias fremste motorshow, med utfordringer, vurderinger og kjendisgjester.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond og James May hjelper flomrammede Storbritannia ved å bygge en luftputebil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Del 1 av 2. Mange oppdagere hevder å ha funnet Nilens utspring, men Top Gear-trioen mener de kan reise lengre og raskere ved hjelp av viljestyrke, oppfinnsomhet og stasjonsvogner.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Det første Top Gear Bobil Grand Prix blir en braksuksess og den nye Honda Civic Type-R testes for å se om den er like god som originalen.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: The Western Allies secure supply routes that will allow them to enter Germany, and the Ardennes counter-offensive fails. The Red Army advances rapidly. The SS implements the Holocaust.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Giancarlo Esposito
programme.desc: Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad / Revolution / The Usual Suspects) tells the story of his former home in Ridgefield, CT.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Roddy Piper
programme.desc: "Rowdy" Roddy Piper (legendary WWE wrestler) is paid a visit by Kim at his home in Portland, Oregon as he seeks answers to the ghost experiences.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Jay Thomas
programme.desc: Jay Thomas (Cheers / Murphy Brown) visits his former home in Santa Barbara, California.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Tito Ortiz

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this brand-new series of Dirty Home Rescue, Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Toni from Telford whose house is so dirty her partner of 10 years, Rich, won’t move in with her.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 2
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Bill and Antionette from Newport, who share their home with their 3 cats. They admit they’ve not deep cleaned their home since they moved in.

programme.desc: This former Methodist Episcopal church in Bryan, Ohio, stands on ground once part of the town's original cemetery. Before the church's construction, graves were exhumed and moved, yet rumors persisted that six graves remained unaccounted for.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Indiana State Asylum
programme.desc: Nick Groff visits a sanatorium in Indiana and conducts a paranormal investigation.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Joe Pantoliano

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Travis Tritt
programme.desc: Country music legend, Travis Tritt is living in fear of the inexplicable paranormal experiences he is having at his lakeside cabin nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Georgia.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tiffany, Tony Plana, Morgan Brittany
programme.desc: An angry teenage Tiffany reads the Satanic bible and unleashes evil from the other side. Tony Plana encounters a cannibalistic entity that leaves him fearing for his life.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 703

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 704

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 705

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 706
programme.desc: Mie og Jakob har flyttet inn hos Jakobs mor for å spare til drømmehuset. Men er drømmehuset i det hele tatt på markedet? Tobias argumenterer for sin sak, og Mie og Jakob får seg et sjokk.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 707

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of 11-year-old Krista Harrison, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
programme.desc: Tasha wants to prove to her ex Martin that he fathered her four-year-old. Martin's sister says that the child might belong to her boyfriend Terrence. Who's the real father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Bullied Out of School
programme.desc: Aabrea and Jerae bullied a high school girl so badly that she dropped out. Can Steve help them resolve their differences and figure out why so many teens turn to bullying?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Extreme Deception Indicated
programme.desc: Joe and Tammy have been together for six years and they have two children. Joe faces cheating accusations again and returns to Steve's stage for his lie detector results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
programme.desc: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Wouldn't Wish This on Anybody
programme.desc: On today's Steve Wilkos, will the lie detector results reveal if Tamisha and Simone's men were faithful? Or will it reveal some more sinister results?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: The Devastating Truth
programme.desc: Desiaree refuses to believe her sister or mother's accusations against her father. Are their lies are keeping him in prison? Find out today!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Second Case
programme.desc: A woman’s mangled body is found beside a lonely stretch of highway. When the coroner suspects foul play, Kenda is called in to solve the second homicide case of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Settle the Score
programme.desc: When Johnny Crawford is killed in his easy chair, police are perplexed to learn he may have been shot over a musical instrument. It soon becomes clear the young man wasn’t killed for his own sins.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Everybody Lies
programme.desc: After church, deacon Robert Walton is beaten to death in a public park. The case heats up when Lt. Kenda and his team revisit an old friend with a secret. Did the religious leader have a dark side?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefanget
